titre: Awzid — Arabic, the Quran and the basics of the religion, step by step
description: Awzid, an online school to learn Arabic, the Quran and the basics of the religion, step by step, as a family. Closed beta, by invitation: request yours.
h1: Learn Arabic, the Quran and the basics of the religion, step by step, as a family
intro: An online school for children, teenagers and adults: short sessions, the progression of our classroom books, and sources cited.
univers_intro: One single path, from the first alphabet to the basics of practice, to follow alone or as a family.
u1_p: Read, write and understand Arabic, level after level, with audio for every lesson and corrected exercises.
u2_p: Read with colour-coded tajwid, memorise at your own pace and regularly revise what you have learnt.
u3_p: The basics of the religion explained simply: purification, prayer, everyday supplications, always with their sources.
public_intro: Everyone moves at their own pace, on a path suited to their age.
p1_p: A family account, one profile per child, and parents who can see where each one stands.
p2_p: An independent path and short sessions that are easy to fit in between classes.
p3_p: Start from scratch or go back over the basics, at your own pace and without pressure.
p4_p: The progression of our printed books to support your classes; a space for teachers is in preparation.
e1_p: 10 to 20 minutes, a few times a week: enough to make progress without getting tired of it.
e2_p: Lessons follow the order of our classroom books: each notion builds on the previous one.
e3_p: Parents see the sessions completed, the progress made and what is left to review.
c1_p: Practice is presented according to the Maliki school, with sources cited, and the content is under review.
c2_p: No advertising, no selling of data, no tracking of your habits. The app even works without a connection.
c3_p: Your data is hosted in France, in Paris, and is only used for your learning.
